The handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at line 157 after creating a memo. The remaining details are being identified.

The dispatcher lives in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` and calls `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which invokes `webhook.PostAsync(payload)`. The delivery package is `internal/webhook`, using Go's `net/http` via `Post` asynchronously through a worker queue. HMAC-SHA256 signing is applied with headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` formatted as `v1,<base64-signature>`.
